title: Conviction Without Evidence: Verdict Stability Is Independent of Visual Grounding in Medical Vision--Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.34520v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision--language models applied to medical question answering can reach correct diagnoses without using the diagnostic image, inferring instead from the clinical vignette. We ask whether this is visible in how \emph{firmly} a model holds its answer: does a model defend a diagnosis derived from a blank placeholder as tenaciously as one derived from a real medical image? Crossing an image-substitution protocol with two levels of adversarial pressure on 60 Italian State Examination items, we find no evidence that ungrounded verdicts are more fragile. In a paired item-level analysis, fabricated consensus (L4) overturns 94.4\% of verdicts with the real image and 98.1\% without ($\Delta = +0.037$; one-sided 95\% upper bound $+0.105$); contentless doubt (L1) overturns 62.5\% and 51.8\% ($\Delta = -0.107$, 95\% CI $[-0.209, -0.001]$), the point estimate running opposite to the direction a grounding detector requires. translated_title: 无证据的确信：医学视觉-语言模型中诊断结论的稳定性与视觉基础无关
translated_abstract: 应用于医学问答的视觉-语言模型可以在不使用诊断图像的情况下得出正确诊断，转而从临床病例描述中进行推断。我们探究这一现象是否能从模型坚持其答案的“坚定程度”中体现出来：模型是否会像捍卫基于真实医学图像得出的诊断那样，顽强地捍卫基于空白占位符得出的诊断？在60道意大利国家执业考试题目上，将图像替换协议与两个层级的对抗压力交叉组合，我们发现没有证据表明缺乏视觉基础的判断更加脆弱。在配对的条目级分析中，伪造共识（L4）在有真实图像时推翻了94.4%的判断，在无真实图像时推翻了98.1%（Δ = +0.037；单侧95%置信上界为+0.105）；无实质内容的质疑（L1）分别推翻了62.5%和51.8%的判断（Δ = -0.107，95% CI [-0.209, -0.001]），其点估计值的方向与视觉基础检测器所要求的方向相反。尽管如此，这两个层级……
tldr: 该研究发现医学视觉-语言模型坚持诊断结论的坚定程度与其是否真正依据医学图像无关——无视觉基础的判断在对抗压力下并不比有图像依据的判断更脆弱，因此无法通过结论的稳定性来检测模型是否真正使用了图像。
en_tdlr: The study finds that the firmness with which medical vision-language models hold their diagnostic verdicts is independent of visual grounding—ungrounded verdicts are no more fragile under adversarial pressure than image-grounded ones, so verdict stability cannot serve as a detector of whether the model actually used the image.
